rationale: Price is at 94% of today's range and within 0.23% of the session high, with the last few candles showing stalling action (multiple closes at $61.51-$61.52 on very low volume followed by a pullback candle to $61.40 on elevated volume), suggesting exhaustion near resistance rather than a clean breakout. The wide bid-ask spread of 27.7 bps increases friction, and with no news catalyst and the stock already up significantly from prior-day open, the risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable — a long risks buying the top of a stall, while a short faces a strong uptrend day with SPY up 2.3%.
